---
name: Report a theme
about: Flag a published theme as deceptive, infringing, or malicious.
title: "[report] "
labels: takedown-report
---

<!-- See GOVERNANCE.md → Takedown policy. -->

**Theme (slug / folder):** `themes/<slug>/`

**Reason for the report:**

- [ ] **Deceptive** — a valid palette engineered to mislead (e.g. `--danger`
      made to look safe, unreadable-by-design contrast).
- [ ] **Infringing** — clones a trademarked brand or a paid/proprietary theme, or
      otherwise violates the CC-BY-4.0 grant.
- [ ] **Malicious / abusive** — weaponized theme surface, or abusive metadata.

**Details / evidence:**

<!--
Note: takedown removes the theme from the repo + gallery. It cannot uninstall
copies already downloaded to a device — Myne is local-first and never reaches
into your device. Re-validation on import remains the client-side safety.
-->
